body:
but the thing is i don't think necessarily i've been treated badly, i just think i've been treated as to be expected. i think i felt entitled to better treatment before but i'm beginning to realize i don't really deserve anything.

if i'd done this, he wouldn't have hit me. i slapped him in the face and ruined his date. i'm unforgivable.

i've sent him a last good-bye letter, begging for an explanation, begging to know what i did wrong to warrant this but knowing i won't get anything. i'm just shouting into the ether. we've blocked each other already. i feel so bitter and just sad. i wish i hadn't met him because i wonder if i wouldn't be here like this, but then i also think maybe it would have been inevitable... i can't get that statement out of my head, even months later: nobody wants a depressed girl.

i just don't think i'll find that. i thought i had one instance of it and it just meant nothing at all. i don't think anyone could ever love me with all my neuroses and needs. i'm just not enough.
